# iosxe_wireless_ap_tags (Resource)

This resource can manage the static tag assignment of multiple access points (`ap <mac>`) in a single resource. The map key is the AP MAC address in lowercase colon form (e.g. `00:53:00:03:00:01`), as the device stores and returns it that way. Only the MAC addresses present in `items` are managed; entries configured outside Terraform are left untouched. Tags left unset fall back to `default-policy-tag`, `default-site-tag` and `default-rf-tag`; the device does not return a tag that is explicitly set to its default name, so leave such tags unset instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iosxe_wireless_ap_tags" "example" {
  items = {
    "00:53:00:03:00:01" = {
      policy_tag = "S3-PT-TEST"
      site_tag   = "S3-ST-TEST"
      rf_tag     = "S3-RT-TEST"
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `delete_mode` (String) Configure behavior when deleting/destroying the resource. Either delete the entire object (YANG container) being managed, or only delete the individual resource attributes configured explicitly and leave everything else as-is. Default value is `all`.
  - Choices: `all`, `attributes`
- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.
- `items` (Attributes Map) The items of this resource, keyed by their identity.
  - Map key: `mac` (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the object.

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Optional:

- `policy_tag` (String) Configuration of policy tag
- `rf_tag` (String) Configuration of rf tag
- `site_tag` (String) Site Tag configuration for an AP. APs with same named Site Tag form a site. Cisco recommendations for number of APs in a site vary by platform and deployment model. Please follow these recommendation for your platform and deployment model

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import iosxe_wireless_ap_tags.example ""
```
